comparison.objective: Support a bar while withdrawing its carriage, then lower it into a cradle; candidate breaks and collects insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous load support during support-surface removal and controlled lowering versus coaxial mandrel stabilization during discrete hammer impacts and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Bar stored without exceeding drop or tilt limits versus four tang fractures and complete containment with retained insert poses. Exact numeric bar limits are not present in the record.
comparison.reason: Load transfer and support sequencing are meaningfully different from precision impact fracture and post-fracture debris recovery.
